label: Authority impersonation
description: Someone claims to represent a government agency, law enforcement, a court, or another authority.

label: Bank impersonation
description: Someone claims to be a bank employee and directs the customer to transfer funds.

label: External instruction
description: Another person told the customer where or how to send the payment.

label: Urgency or time pressure
description: The customer was told to act immediately or before a deadline.

label: Threat or fear
description: The request includes a threat of arrest, loss, punishment, or harm.

label: Secrecy request
description: The customer was told not to consult the bank, family, or another trusted person.

label: Move money to keep it safe
description: Someone claims funds must be moved to a protected or safe account.

label: Remote technical support
description: An unsolicited support representative requests access or payment.

label: Family emergency
description: A supposed relative or intermediary claims an urgent family crisis.

label: Guaranteed investment returns
description: An investment is described as guaranteed or risk-free with unusual returns.

label: Unusual payment instructions
description: The customer is directed to use an unusual recipient, account, or payment rail.
